rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds a valid NMSB 7310:2015 quality management certification, currently valid until 30 June 2027, satisfying this requirement in full.
Visakoivu Oy holds unrestricted electrical contracting rights, class S1, which is the highest classification under the Finnish scheme and exceeds the class S2 minimum requested.
Visakoivu Oy holds a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate, and will ensure it remains current at submission and through the framework period.
Visakoivu Oy's revenue for the 2025 financial year, its most recently closed year, was EUR 20,300,000, comfortably above the turnover threshold required in this section.
Visakoivu Oy employs 62 professionals in its HVAC (LVI) discipline, well above the minimum required in this section.

Visakoivu Oy's largest comparable reference project, REF02 for Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue (a five-health-station facilities and HVAC framework), had a contract value of EUR 1,650,000, well above the minimum required in this section.

Visakoivu Oy proposes scheduled HVAC maintenance visits at intervals set by system type and criticality, each followed by a written service report submitted within two working days through the framework's shared reporting system, covering condition observations, work performed, and any follow-up actions required.

On contract start, Visakoivu Oy will jointly verify the Buyer's asset register and technical documentation against a physical walk-through of each property, record any discrepancies in writing, and maintain the register as a living document for the duration of the framework.

Personnel assigned to this contract hold trade qualifications appropriate to their discipline, including electrical contracting rights and F-gas refrigerant handling qualifications where the work requires them, and will complete the Buyer's site-access and induction requirements for health and social care premises before starting work.

Statutory lift inspections are scheduled and tracked against the inspection body's certificates for each lift, with inspection and maintenance records filed in the property's technical documentation and made available to the Buyer on request.

Visakoivu Oy's occupational safety plan for this contract operates under its NMSB 75310 occupational health and safety management system, and covers task-specific risk assessment, permit-to-work procedures for higher-risk tasks, and coordination with the Buyer's own infection-control and access rules in patient-care areas.

Visakoivu Oy's building automation team of 18 specialists works routinely with both BACnet and Modbus protocols and confirms compatibility with the Buyer's existing systems; any integration work identified during the asset-register handover (see Section 4.2) will be scoped and quoted separately before work begins.

Typical lead time for common HVAC, electrical, and automation spare parts is 3-5 working days from Visakoivu Oy's own stock or supplier network; for discontinued equipment, Visakoivu Oy sources compatible replacement components or proposes a retrofit option in consultation with the Buyer before committing to a repair.

Completed maintenance and repair work is checked against a written completion checklist specific to the system worked on, signed off by a supervisor independent of the technician who performed the work, under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 7310 quality management system.

If a reported fault is not resolved within the agreed response time, the case is automatically escalated to Visakoivu Oy's on-call supervisor, and, if still unresolved after a further two hours, to the service manager responsible for the framework, with the Buyer's facilities contact notified at each escalation step.

Visakoivu Oy proposes an annual energy review of the maintained HVAC and automation systems, identifying low-cost adjustments (setpoint and schedule optimisation, damper and control-loop tuning) in the first year and capital-improvement options for the Buyer's separate consideration thereafter, consistent with its NMSB 74210 environmental management system.

Fire protection systems are tested and maintained on the schedule set by the applicable standards and the equipment manufacturers' requirements, with test and maintenance records filed against each property and made available to the Buyer and the rescue authority on request.

Each property is assigned a named primary and backup technician, and Visakoivu Oy maintains up-to-date handover documentation for every site so that a departing or reassigned team member can be replaced without a gap in service continuity.

Visakoivu Oy proposes response and resolution targets differentiated by fault category, with the shortest targets applied to faults affecting patient-care areas or life-safety systems and longer targets for non-critical faults; the full proposed matrix is set out in the commercial schedule accompanying this tender.

Visakoivu Oy will run a rolling programme of statutory periodic inspection of electrical installations across the properties, sequenced so that no installation exceeds its required inspection interval, under its class S1 electrical contracting rights.

Following any equipment replacement or major repair, Visakoivu Oy runs a commissioning checklist covering functional testing, safety interlocks, and control-system integration, and issues a signed commissioning certificate to the Buyer before the equipment is returned to normal service.

Refrigeration and cooling equipment on site is maintained under Visakoivu Oy's F-gas regulation qualification, including the leak-checking intervals the regulation sets by refrigerant charge size and the associated recordkeeping.

Visakoivu Oy proposes to limit its liability under the framework agreement to the limits of its liability insurance cover, save for liability that cannot be limited by law, in line with Liite D Section 6 of the draft agreement.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a tiered discount on unit-priced parts and materials as annual call-off volume under the framework increases, with the discount applied retrospectively each contract year once the relevant volume tier is confirmed; exact tier thresholds are set out in the commercial schedule accompanying this tender.
All prices in Visakoivu Oy's tender are quoted in euro.

Visakoivu Oy's pricing structure distinguishes a fixed annual price for scheduled maintenance visits, unit prices for parts and materials drawn down against actual use, and a time-based hourly rate for call-out work outside scheduled visits, all set out in the commercial schedule accompanying this tender.

Visakoivu Oy proposes monthly invoicing and can invoice electronically in the Finnish national e-invoicing format (Finvoice), or another format the Buyer's financial systems require, to be confirmed during contract finalisation.

Visakoivu Oy notes that the main body of this invitation (Section 5.8) states a payment term of 30 days net, while Liite B (B.3) states a payment term of 14 days net; Visakoivu Oy confirms its acceptance of the payment term in principle and asks the Buyer to confirm which of the two stated terms governs before the framework agreement is signed.
Where subcontractors are used, Visakoivu Oy will disclose the subcontracted scope and the corresponding cost component to the Buyer on request, distinguishing it from Visakoivu Oy's own direct cost.

Visakoivu Oy notes the payment term of 30 days net from invoice date stated in this section, which differs from the 14 days net stated in Liite B (B.3); see Visakoivu Oy's response to Section 5.6 for its position pending the Buyer's clarification.
Visakoivu Oy will complete and enclose the reference form (Liite 2), listing REF02 (Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue) among the reference projects relied upon to satisfy Section 3.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a current certificate of tax payment with its tender.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a description of its NMSB 7310 quality management system with its tender, covering the elements relevant to this framework's scope.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract, including their trade qualifications and relevant project experience.
Visakoivu Oy quotes its prices in EUR per square metre per year, as required, and not in EUR per month.
Visakoivu Oy will submit its tender through the delivery channel and in the number of copies specified in the Buyer's procurement unit instructions.
All monetary figures in Visakoivu Oy's tender are rounded to two decimal places.
Visakoivu Oy's tender document uses a minimum font size of 11 pt throughout.
Visakoivu Oy notes that the closing date and time for tenders is 6 November 2026 at 14:00 Finnish time (EET/EEST as applicable), as stated in Section 9, and will submit before that deadline.

Visakoivu Oy performs the great majority of this framework's work with its own staff; where a trade is subcontracted, the subcontractor is selected from Visakoivu Oy's approved supplier list, is qualified to the same standard required of Visakoivu Oy's own staff, and is supervised on site by a Visakoivu Oy foreman who signs off the completed work.

Installation and replacement works in occupied buildings are sequenced outside patient-care hours where possible, with temporary containment, noise and dust control, and a pre-agreed isolation plan for the affected system, coordinated with the property's facilities contact before work commences.

Visakoivu Oy's preventive maintenance plan covers HVAC, electrical, lifts, fire protection, and building automation, with inspection intervals set by system criticality and manufacturer recommendation, ranging from monthly checks on life-safety systems to annual deeper inspections on lower-criticality plant.

Visakoivu Oy proposes differentiated response times by fault severity and maintains continuous on-call cover outside normal working hours through its own rostered technicians, backed by the escalation path described in Section 4.9 of the main body.
Visakoivu Oy offers a warranty period of 24 months on equipment and materials it installs under this framework agreement, in line with its standard terms.

Visakoivu Oy will provide operational training to the Buyer's property staff on the maintained systems, including building automation controls, at handover and again after any significant system change during the framework period.

Visakoivu Oy proposes an annual visual inspection of roofing, facades, and building fabric across the properties, with findings reported alongside the technical maintenance reporting described in Section 4.1, and any structural concerns referred to a qualified building surveyor.

Visakoivu Oy provides round-the-clock, on-call cover from its own Jyvaskyla-based staff in Finland, with no part of the out-of-hours response outsourced outside the country; this satisfies the absolute requirement stated in this section.
Visakoivu Oy will log every maintenance visit in the framework's reporting system on the day it is carried out, as required by this section.
Materials used in maintenance and repair work under this framework will meet the technical standards applicable to health and social care premises, as required by this section.
Personnel working in patient-care areas will observe the Buyer's infection-control and access instructions at all times, as required by this section.
Any deviation Visakoivu Oy proposes from the scope described in this annex will be agreed with the Buyer's technical contact in writing before work commences.

Visakoivu Oy proposes a bonus-malus scheme under which a bonus of a small percentage of the affected period's invoiced maintenance fee applies for sustained over-performance against the agreed service level targets, and an equivalent malus applies for sustained under-performance, calculated quarterly and confirmed in writing to the Buyer; exact percentages are set out in the commercial schedule accompanying this tender.
Visakoivu Oy proposes annual price adjustment using the Finnish Statistical Bureau's building maintenance cost index, with October as the reference month for each year's adjustment.

Visakoivu Oy's quoted prices remain valid for the 120-day period stated, and will not be revised during that period other than in accordance with the indexation clause described in its response to B.2.

Visakoivu Oy notes the payment term of 14 days net stated in this section, which differs from the 30 days net stated in the main body (Section 5.8); see Visakoivu Oy's response to Section 5.6 for its position pending the Buyer's clarification.

Every invoice Visakoivu Oy issues under this framework will reference the relevant call-off order number and the property to which the work relates, and Visakoivu Oy will not delay payment of an undisputed invoice line because another line is disputed.
All of Visakoivu Oy's framework pricing, including any indexed adjustments, will be expressed and administered in euro.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a trade register extract issued no earlier than three months before the closing date.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a confidentiality undertaking signed by an authorised representative.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a certificate of pension insurance payments covering its own personnel.

Visakoivu Oy will ensure that personnel assigned to this contract meet the qualification requirements described in this tender and remain suitably qualified throughout the contract period, including any extension exercised by the Buyer.
Visakoivu Oy maintains liability insurance appropriate to this scope of work, with current cover of EUR 2,000,000, for the duration of the agreement.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this tender in response to Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue's invitation for a technical and property maintenance framework (Reference JHVA-2026-TEK-014). Visakoivu Oy previously delivered a facilities and HVAC maintenance framework for this same wellbeing county across five health stations (2021-2024, reference REF02) and looks forward to continuing that relationship under the terms set out in this tender.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy, founded in 1994 and based in Jyvaskyla, is a technical and property services company employing approximately 180 people across HVAC, electrical, building automation, and facilities management disciplines in Central Finland and the surrounding region.
